author: Dominic Farsi
text:

Top view.
High protein content has become a selling point on foods ranging from breakfast cereals to yoghurts. For anyone hoping to build muscle or stay strong as they age, choosing the product with the most protein can seem sensible. But whether an extra serving will help depends on what they already eat and how they use their muscles.Powered By 10 ShareNextStaySomeone who regularly lifts weights may benefit from additional protein to support muscle growth. An older person with a small appetite may need help getting enough to maintain strength. Someone already eating enough protein may gain little from adding more.Understanding those differences can make it easier to decide whether to change your diet, buy a supplement or concentrate on exercise.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
